results.criterion: With a test-created Surveyor layer loaded in GIS, the layer is identifiable in Map layers or the legend, and opening its Display Settings shows a recordable Show linked sites checkbox state.
steps_taken: Navigated to https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher, waited for the visible launcher, and saved this criterion's initial PNG.
Opened GIS from the launcher and waited for the map loading indicator to disappear.
Opened Surveyor and added one test-created layer using the unchanged default configuration: Service, Last 30 days, All teams, all default technologies, No network filter.
Confirmed Surveyor - Service in Map layers and the legend; no pre-existing map layers were present.
Opened Display Settings and observed Show linked sites checked and Show linked cells unchecked.
Captured the decisive final PNG and read the current browser URL before cleanup.
Closed Display Settings and removed only this test-created layer; Map layers disappeared.
results.reason: Surveyor - Service is identifiable in Map layers and the legend. Display Settings shows Show linked sites checked. Cleanup completed without changing the checkbox.

results.criterion: With the same Surveyor layer loaded and Display Settings closed, after recording a settled initial map scale, selecting zoom-in once produces a closer settled map scale and the same layer remains identifiable in Map layers or the legend.
steps_taken: Navigated to https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher, waited for the visible launcher, and saved this criterion's initial PNG.
Opened GIS from the launcher and waited for the map loading indicator to disappear.
Opened Surveyor and added one test-created layer using the unchanged default configuration: Service, Last 30 days, All teams, all default technologies, No network filter.
Confirmed Surveyor - Service in Map layers and the legend; no pre-existing map layers were present.
Opened Display Settings and recorded Show linked sites checked, then closed it with Escape.
Recorded the settled initial scale as 100 km, with Surveyor - Service still loaded.
Selected Zoom in once, waited for settling, and observed 50 km with Surveyor - Service still in Map layers and the legend.
Captured the decisive final PNG and read the current browser URL before cleanup.

During cleanup, the first Zoom out click timed out because the Zoom in tooltip intercepted pointer events; no zoom-out transition occurred. Hovered Search Map, waited for the tooltip to disappear, and retried Zoom out once successfully to 100 km.
Removed only the test-created layer and confirmed Map layers disappeared.
results.reason: One Zoom in changed the settled visible scale from 100 km to 50 km. The same loaded Surveyor - Service layer remained identifiable. Cleanup completed; the tooltip interception was recovered during cleanup.

results.criterion: After the zoom-in criterion passes, selecting zoom-out once returns the map to the recorded initial scale and the same Surveyor layer remains available without being added again.

conciseReport: All four canonical criteria passed in independent launcher-started journeys. Default Surveyor - Service was identifiable; Show linked sites was checked. Zoom in changed the settled scale from 100 km to 50 km, and zoom out restored 100 km while retaining the same layer. The checkbox remained checked after the complete journey. All 64 criterion-owned PNGs decoded successfully, including separate initial and decisive final captures. All test-created layers were removed. A tooltip intercepted a cleanup zoom-out click in criterion 2; moving the pointer and retrying restored the map. No claim is made about linked-site data completeness or persistence across reload/login.
reason: Testing completed; results and evidence are staged for review.
